newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-GRIQUAS FIGHT BACK AGAINST BOLAND.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GRIQUAS FIGHT BACK AGAINST BOLAND.

With the home side cruising on 155 for three in their second
innings, the Griquas bowlers struck back to claim the remaining
seven wickets for the addition of only 105 runs.
A fine, collective effort from the Griquas attack largely
offset an entertaining 109-run stand for the fourth-wicket
between Kenny Jackson (70) and his captain Adrian Kuiper (63)
which gave Boland the upper hand shortly before tea.
The visitors then began their revival in the final over
before tea when Jackson played on to a Garth Roe delivery,
although Kuiper was able to defy their bowlers until midway
through the final session with a 113-ball knock which contained
Once Kuiper departed, the Boland lower order folded with the
notable exceptions of Roger Telemachus (29) and Henry Williams
Bowled out for 260, Boland left Griquas with a realistic
chance of snatching victory on the final day needing 279 to win.
